credential: per-attempt machine credential (Authorization: Bearer, X-AQ-Request: 1); project_id, task_id, session_id and attempt_id are taken from the authenticated binding, never from the body

request.body: markdown string, 1..16384 bytes, not blank, no control characters except tab/LF/CR

request.task_id?: uuid; omitted: the attempt's own task. Another task needs comment.read at a scope that reaches it

request.comment_id: uuid of a comment this attempt wrote
request.expected_revision: decimal string, the comment's current revision

response.revision: decimal string, the revision this operation made
